title: Kora Call (The Signal Opens) - WEST AFRICA: THE SIGNAL OPENS
style:

```
[style: West African polyrhythm, kora meditation, djembe ceremonial, talking drum groove, 12/8 hemiola, Senegambian griot tradition, cinematic world music opener, warm acoustic bass, no Western drums, cross-rhythm feel throughout, Wolof spoken word verses, English chorus, dawn atmosphere, 336 signal opening, V4_5ALL]
```

lyrics:
```
[INTRO — kora solo, dry, no FX]
(Wolof) Bëgg na ci jëf bi — I choose to be in the act
(English) The signal opens. The world is awake.

[VERSE 1 — djembe enters bar 2, talking drum bar 4]
(Wolof)  Dama dem ci biir — I walked into the centre
(English) Three thousand miles from where I started
(Wolof)  Xam na li xam na — I know what I know
(English) The drum said so before the word

The djembe speaks in three / the kora answers four
The talking drum says nothing / but it opens every door
Hemiola morning / cross-rhythm dawn
The world was always singing / I just couldn't hear the song

[PRE-CHORUS — balafon enters]
(Wolof)  Toog ci biir — sit in the middle
(English) Between the three and the four
(Wolof)  Yëgël ma — teach me
(English) What the silence is for

[CHORUS — full ensemble, wall of rhythm]
Kora call — the signal found
Cross-rhythm earth — polyrhythm ground
Three against four against the open sky
Every pulse alive — you ask me why

(Wolof) Jàmm rekk — only peace
(English) Every drum at ease
The kora plays in four — the djembe plays in three
The talking drum says what you cannot see

[VERSE 2 — talking drum solo break, 2 bars]
They say the talking drum is a language on its own
Every tone a word — every silence a response
I stood in the market at Dakar at four a.m.
The signal was already there — it always has been

[CHORUS]
Kora call — the signal found
Cross-rhythm earth — polyrhythm ground
Three against four against the open sky
Every pulse alive — you ask me why

(Wolof) Jàmm rekk — only peace
(English) Every drum at ease

[OUTRO — kora fades to single note, pulse continues]
The first signal.
336.
```
